notes.title: Introducing Maximum Pro League
notes.content:
In Maximum Football, we wanted to create a fun and competitive card game that also maintained our core vision of allowing players to create their ultimate football universe. Enter Maximum Pro League. 

Maximum Pro League (MPL) is Maximum Football’s unique take on the deckbuilding sports game that allows you to take the game’s powerful customization tools and build the online squad that YOU want to compete with. This is a mode unlike any other in the sports genre. Here’s how. 
[previewyoutube=1_y3bsBj7dI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Starting Your Team[/h2]

In MPL, you won’t be restricted to selecting from a collection of pre-existing teams while you unlock more options. No. In the MPL menu, you will find the exact same team creator that is available to you in the single-player game. Upload custom logos, create home, away, and alternate uniforms, and set your team’s name, city and playbooks. You MPL team is your opportunity to express your creativity on the field. 

When you first log into MPL, you will be given over 60 cards to start your team. These cards can range across MPL’s four rarity levels: common, rare, epic, and legend. This will serve as your starter team and the foundation from which you will build your team. While the players on each card are auto-generated by the game, [b]you can customize the details of any player in your deck[/b]. Rename them, change their appearance, and customize their equipment. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/935f6ee65120adaddc61fa9c13fa30fe83a50fb8.jpg[/img]
Let’s take a closer look at the cards.

Card Content:
[olist]
[*] Position: The position this player is eligible to occupy on the field. 
[*] Card Level: Each card can be increased in level up to level 10. We will talk more about leveling cards later in this blog. 
[*] Personality (only on front): Each player has two personality traits that will give them a slight increase to a specific stat if paired with other players that have the same trait. This is referred to as “chemistry” in your roster. When a card reaches level 10, it receives an additional personality trait. 
[*] Archetype: Each position has different archetypes that dictate what attributes the player is best at and which ones progress the fastest while leveling up. For example, linebackers can be either pass coverage, balanced, or run stoppers. 
[*] Primary Attributes: A player’s primary attributes are the three most important attributes to the player’s archetype.  
[*] Secondary Attributes (only on back): Secondary attributes are the next most important attributes for the archetype. 
[*] Overall: The overall rating of the player, representing his general ability. 
[*] Name: Player names (as well as info and appearance) can be edited in the customization menu found by pressing V when the card is selected. 
[*] Rarity: A card’s rarity dictates its starting overall and overall cap when increased to max level. The higher the rarity, the higher both of these numbers will be. 
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/6d06f3ed29154bac35d712e688f13b0cb2cfd056.png[/img]
Inspecting your card will give you some additional information such as tertiary abilities (other relevant abilities that receive an upgrade at each level), full list of attributes and ratings, an explanation of the player’s archetype and personality traits, as well a list of their relevant statistics. This is also where you will be able to level up your cards. 

From the inspection menu, you are also able to customize your players. Rename them, update their equipment, change their number, and more. You can truly make your MPL team whatever you want them to be. 

[h2]Building Your Roster and Depth Chart[/h2]

Once you have opened your initial packs, it is time to set up your roster. In order for players to be added to your depth chart, they must first be added to your roster. From your collection screen, you can see every card you’ve obtained from the packs you’ve opened. From here, you can organize and filter your cards by position, rarity, and whether or not they are in your roster. 

Your roster is the collection of players that will be available to you to field throughout the game and your depth chart determines who starts and backs up certain positions. 

As you are rostering players, be mindful of their personality traits. These are denoted by an icon in the upper right hand corner of the player’s cards. If you roster enough players with the same personality type, you will receive a small boost to specific ratings. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/935f6ee65120adaddc61fa9c13fa30fe83a50fb8.jpg[/img]
These personality traits and corresponding ratings boosts include:
[list]
[*] Heart - Work Ethic - Increases stamina
[*] Trophy - Competitiveness - Increases speed
[*] Crown - Leadership - Increases acceleration
[*] Star - Professionalism - Increases agility
[*] Fire - Aggression - Increases strength
[/list]

As you stack multiple starting players with matching personality types, you will receive higher attribute boosts. 

[h2]Upgrading Your Team[/h2]

As you play MPL, you will want to consistently upgrade the players on your roster. You can do this in several ways. 

First, you can open card packs. While you can certainly purchase packs from the MPL shop to find new players, you can also unlock card packs and currency through daily log-in rewards and by completing challenges throughout the season. There are daily, weekly, and season-long challenges that you can track via the challenges menu in MPL. 

So, the more you play, the more you can unlock for free! 

You are also able to upgrade your existing cards by consuming unwanted cards in exchange for XP that is applied to an individual card. Each card can be leveled from 1 to 10, a number indicated in the top-right corner of card above the personality trait. Each level gives a ratings boost to the primary abilities of the card, a slightly smaller boost to the secondary abilities, and an even smaller boost to the tertiary abilities of the card. These are determined by the archetype of the card. The higher the rarity, the higher potential overall. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/690ae4911fbf6d353400ed7cd8a1e4fd11897085.jpg[/img]
[h2]Compete Online[/h2]

Once you have your roster and depth chart set, it’s time to take the field with your team. Match up against other MPL teams in fast-paced 4-minute quarter games. MPL’s matchmaking system will attempt to matchmake you with teams of a similar caliber. 

You can also compete offline against CPU opponents that get stronger the more you improve your team. 

Throughout the season, the game will track your wins, losses, best win streak, and other statistics. You’ll be able to track how you stack up against the field using the in-game leaderboard. The more you play and win, the higher you will climb throughout the season. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/1a643c0a349f3b6fe7e2ee07ae946b2a9140b37b.jpg[/img]
[h2]Play Maximum Pro League on November 7th[/h2]

Maximum Football releases with Exhibition, Dynasty Mode, and Maximum Pro League to Steam Early Access on November 7th. Wishlist the game now and join the Discord server to get ready for the launch next month!

notes.title: What To Expect from Maximum Football on November 7th
notes.content:
Maximum Football launches to Steam Early Access on November 7th. Here is what to expect from the free-to-play experience and what some of the premium modes and features look like. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/9c5214b82b25f9ae0231536148d58fc766007e32.jpg[/img]
[h2]Base Game - Free[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Maximum Pro League[/b] - MPL is Maximum’s competitive online mode. Come back next week for more details on MPL. 
[*] [b]Customization Suite[/b] - Get full, unlimited access to Maximum Football’s powerful customization suite. Create hundreds of teams that can be used in different Maximum Football game modes. Edit every player in the game’s names, details, ratings, accessories, and equipment. 
[*] [b]Single Player Exhibition[/b] - Take the field with one of 130 pre-made teams or any of your custom-made teams and compete against the CPU. 
[*] [b]Dynasty Starter Mode[/b] - Get access to several seasons of Maximum Football’s fully-customizable Dynasty Mode. Import up to 130 custom teams and select which program you want to build into a powerhouse. Earn additional seasons by completing daily and weekly challenges in other game modes at no additional cost. 
[/list]
[h2]Dynasty Edition - $19.99 USD[/h2]
Dynasty Edition provides premium access to Dynasty Mode so you can play as many seasons you want without earning access through daily and weekly challenges. That’s where the Dynasty Edition comes in. Here’s what’s included:
[list]
[*] [b]Base Game[/b] - Get everything that’s included in the base game. 
[*] [b]Unlimited Dynasty Mode Access[/b] - Get the same great fully-customizable Dynasty Mode without having to worry about earning additional seasons. Start as many new saves and play as many seasons as you want. 
[*] [b]Dynasty Pack[/b] - Get access to exclusive cosmetics, including Dynasty gloves, helmet, pants, mask, and fireball celebration. 
[/list]
[h2]Legend Edition - $39.99[/h2]
Get access to an exclusive stadium and cosmetics, as well as unlimited Access to Dynasty mode now and Franchise mode when it launches in 2025. The Legend Edition includes:
[list]
[*] [b]Base Game[/b] - Get everything that’s included in the base game. 
[*] [b]Unlimited Dynasty Mode Access[/b]
[*] [b]Dynasty Pack[/b]
[*] [b]Unlimited Franchise Access[/b] - Play Maximum Football’s Franchise mode with no restrictions when it launches in 2025. 
[*] [b]Franchise Pack[/b] - A similar cosmetic pack to the one included in Dynasty. Details to come. 
[*] [b]Legend Pack[/b] - Get access to an exclusive stadium, mouth guard, and knee drop celebration, as well as 1200 Max Stacks (Maximum Football’s in-game currency). 
[/list]

Maximum Football, at its core, is a free-to-play experience. All of the premium game modes (Dynasty and Franchise) can be earned with enough game time in other modes. 

We can’t wait for everyone to get their hands on Maximum Football when it launches on November 7th. Stay tuned for more information as we prepare for release.

notes.title: Maximum Football Comes to Steam Early Access November 7th
notes.content:
We won’t bury the lede. Maximum Football is coming to [b]Steam Early Access on November 7th[/b]! We announced Maximum Football’s return back in 2021, and over the last three years, we have built a realistic, physics-based simulation football game from the ground up. The journey has been a long one, and we want to thank you for your patience and continued support.

November 7th marks an exciting moment for both our team and for everyone who has been eagerly waiting for Maximum Football to release. 

But this isn’t the end of anything. In fact, this is just the start of the work we’ve been promising from the beginning - building the best football simulation available WITH YOU!
[previewyoutube=nQVHqbfC3Gk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What is included in Early Access?[/h2]
The Early Access build will be loaded with a variety of features and modes from the jump. On November 7th, you will be have access to the following: 
[olist]
[*] [b]Exhibition Mode[/b]: Play a head-to-head match up with any of the 130 pre-made teams in Maximum Football or your own created teams. 
[*] [b]College Dynasty[/b]: Take over as your program’s Coach and Athletic Director in this fully customizable mode. Scout, recruit, gameplan, and manage your college’s football budget and facilities to lead your team to glory. [url=https://www.maxfootballgame.com/everything-you-need-to-know-about-dynasty-in-maximum-football/]If you missed our Dynasty Deep Dive, you can check it out here. [/url]
[*] [b]Online Multiplayer[/b]: Face off against other Maximum Football players in online head-to-head. 
[*] [b]The Maximum Football Customization Suite[/b]: Create a team, create a player, and edit every aspect of your team in Maximum Football’s robust and unparalleled creation studio. All available within the game! 
[/olist]

More modes will follow shortly, such as Franchise Mode (professional football), with much more planned over the coming months and years as Maximum Football continues to evolve. Your feedback will help shape the game and balance the competitive play, so we encourage you to provide feedback and input via the official Maximum Football [url=http://discord.gg/S8yg7EG2gA]Discord[/url] and [url=https://x.com/MaxFootballGame]X[/url] to assist in creating the best football game possible.

[h2]Why Early Access on Steam only?[/h2]
Early Access is an important tool for us to gather feedback directly from you, the community, so we can make the most realistic, physics-based football simulation game possible by the time we are ready for our big release on console and PC 1.0. As the community gets their hands on Maximum Football for the first time in November, there are certain to be improvements, bugs, and additional features that you will want to address, and we will use this to make the game better. 

Steam’s Early Access program gives us the ability to 1. Get Maximum Football in your hands faster and 2. take your feedback and iterate on the game more quickly over time to help us reach full release faster. By the time we reach 1.0 on other platforms, Maximum Football will have changed for the better based on early adopters’ feedback. 
[h2]Get Ready For Maximum Football[/h2]
Maximum Football releases on November 7th, but you can get ready for the game today. Wishlist it on Steam, join the Maximum Football Discord server, and follow us on social media. We will have tons more to share over the next two months, so stay tuned.

notes.title: Everything You Need to Know About Dynasty in Maximum Football
notes.content:
We have said from the start that the biggest difference between Maximum Football and other football games on the market is that it will include both College Football and Professional Football. When the game launches into Early Access, you will have your first opportunity to get your hands on our College Football mode Dynasty. 

In Maximum Football’s Dynasty mode, you will serve your university in two capacities: Coach and Athletic Director. This allows you an unprecedented level of control over decisions on how to take your team to glory. Throughout the years (which there is no limit to how many seasons you can play), your league will evolve. 

In this blog, we’re highlighting how Maximum Football will give you the ability to create the college football universe you want to and take your program from the bottom of the barrel to the mountaintop of hoisting a championship trophy.

[h1]Dynasty Set-Up[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/571c99c51df105a2c266131ca094c610146b6211.jpg[/img]
[h2]Pick Team[/h2]
The biggest decision for your dynasty journey will be selecting which team you’d like to take over. Do you want to go for back-to-back championships with an existing powerhouse or take a low-rated team and build them up over time?

From the pick-a-team menu, you can select from the 130 premade teams, or import your own to replace one of them.. When we say that you can make the league you’ve always dreamed of, we mean it. You can replace all 130 teams with ones of your own design if you would like to.

Each team has a few traits you will want to pay attention to in this menu:
[list]
[*] [b]Overall, Offense, and Defense Ratings:[/b] These are pretty simple and straightforward. These numbers represent the aggregate skill level of the players that make up the team to start. 
[*] [b]Conference: [/b]The conference you participate in will determine the level of competition that you face throughout your conference schedule. More on conferences in the next section. 
[*] [b]Location: [/b]Your team’s location will play an important role in recruiting players to come to your program. More on that later in the blog. 
[*] [b]Total Budget:[/b] Each school has its own preset starting budget. This budget will be used for hiring your coach, and upgrading your stadium and facilities. Obviously, the higher the budget the more freedom you will have to make these upgrades early on.
[/list]
[h2]Customize Conferences[/h2]
Next, you can customize your conferences. Move teams around, rename conferences, and upload custom logos for each of the 12 conferences. Each conference is assigned an overall rank based on the aggregate overalls of the teams in the conference. As you move teams around, those overalls will reflect the strength of the new schools being added and removed from the conference.

Each conference also has a rank. You can edit these ranks manually from the set up menu or select an option to automatically assign ranks based on overall of the adjusted conferences.

Maximum Football’s default conference realignment system works using a relegation-promotion system. The bottom two teams in a conference at the end of the season are demoted to the conference that ranks below the one they were in while the top two from the conference will move to the conference that ranks right above the one they competed in the year prior.

Of course, you will also have the option to manually realign conferences at the end of the season, but more on that later.

[h2]Pick a Coach[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/62f15b3ba207e064d0f07ea60a591474781ed9d6.jpg[/img]
Your coach will define every aspect of your teambuilding and Xs and Os strategy. On this screen, you will see quite a bit of relevant information that will shape your program’s future.
[list]
[*] [b]Coach Level:[/b] The coach's level of experience. The higher the coach's level, the higher their cost to hire. However, the increased level also means they will come with better ratings and abilities. 
[*] [b]Offense and Defensive Playbook:[/b] These are the offensive and defensive schemes that each coach will have your team adopt. These can be changed once you start your dynasty. 
[*] [b]Overall Record:[/b] This is the coach’s career record before being hired by your school. 
[*] [b]Coach Ratings:[/b] Scouting, Charisma, Stability, Player Development, Reputation, Consistency of Success
[*] [b]Cost of Hiring:[/b] The one-time cost of hiring your coach. For schools with a lower starting budget, you will have to decide on a cheaper coach that may have lower ratings.
[/list]

[h2]League Settings[/h2]
On the final set-up screen, you are presented with several additional options for your league. These include:
[list]
[*] [b]Preseason Duration:[/b] Choose the number of weeks you would like preseason to last. Each week you will be able to recruit, scout, and upgrade players. 
[*] [b]Regular Season Duration:[/b] Choose how many weeks you would like the season to last. 
[*] [b]League Size:[/b] Reduce the number of teams competing in your league from the default 130. 
[*] [b]Playoffs Bracket Size:[/b] Determine whether you want 4, 16, or 32 teams competing at the end of the season for the championship trophy. 
[*] [b]Quarter Duration:[/b] Choose how long each quarter will last. 
[*] [b]Accelerated Clock:[/b] This setting causes the play clock to fast forward to a set time after play selection, allowing you to play longer quarters while maintaining a more realistic number of plays each team runs. 
[*] [b]Conference Realignment:[/b] Choose how often conferences will relegate and promote teams.
[/list]

[h1]Preseason[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/4747f3460d875ebcca25586b7af433dc8fd89c1b.jpg[/img]
Now that your dynasty is set-up, it’s time to turn your sights toward your team. Preseason is the time to assess your players, fill your recruiting board, and take stock of your school’s facilities and stadium. All of these will have a major impact on the growth and success of your program.

[h2]Roster Set-Up[/h2]
The first thing that you should do when you start your dynasty is take a look at your roster. Assess where your team’s strengths and weaknesses lie, redshirt players to keep an extra year of eligibility, set your depth chart and cut players who you don’t see having a role in your program’s future.

[h2]Recruiting[/h2]
Recruiting is the lifeblood of college football. Being able to scout talent and convince them that their best chance at success is at your school is what separates competitive programs from perennial failures. In Maximum Football, our goal is for you to learn about and build relationships with your recruits throughout the season as you pitch for them to come to your school.

[h3]Setting up your Recruiting Board[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/e6d1e0264981ce646088195e77b7a0fa1e356dad.jpg[/img]
The first step to building your recruiting class is identifying prospects that are interested in your school and match your school’s needs, so that you can add them to your recruiting board. At the start of preseason, all information about recruits besides their name, position, home state, and recruit rank are hidden. You will need to use “Prestige” during recruiting to unlock vital information about recruits and take actions to increase their interest in your program.

The best place to start recruiting is in your school’s home state. Recruits who live closer to your campus are more likely to be interested in attending your school. The first unlock on a recruit will reveal a bevy of useful information that will help you decide if you want to further pursue that player. This info includes their height, weight, interest level, recruit grade, and several different combine results that give key information about their rating potential.

This initial report will also let you see if the recruit has hidden upside.

Continuing to spend Prestige points here will start to reveal the actual ratings of the recruit.

Once you’ve identified talented players with interest in your school, you can add them to your recruiting board.

[h3]Building Interest[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/3f5b502b367e0a3f8c15b1bb94242f2b1d421f51.jpg[/img]
Each week, you will accrue more Prestige points that can be spent on scouting recruits and building their interest in attending your school. There are multiple ways to interact with your recruits that require varying levels of Prestige investment. The goal in recruiting is to find talented players, identify what is motivating their decision, and make your school seem like the best option for them. Here are the actions you can take each week:
[olist]
[*] [b]Contact: [/b]Start learning more about your recruit by contacting them. There are three methods of contact, each with their own purpose. 
[*] [b]Email:[/b] When you email a recruit, you can choose up to three pitches to either unlock the prospect’s interest level in that area or influence it to become more important to the client. 
[*] [b]Text Message:[/b] Text message conversations with your recruit allow you to focus on individual areas of interest and talk more specifically about the parts of your program that might sway your recruits interest. These are low-risk, low-reward ways to steadily build interest over time. 
[*] [b]Call:[/b] Calling a prospect allows you to make either a soft or hard pitch for one of the areas of interest. These can be a great way to push your recruits' interest in your school forward. But if you make too hard a pitch before building that relationship, it can have a detrimental effect on your efforts. 
[*] [b]Scholarship:[/b] Once your recruit’s interest level increases enough, you can offer your recruit a scholarship to come to your school. This action will also make an impact on your recruit’s interest level. 
[*] [b]Visit:[/b] Finally, you can invite your recruit to visit an upcoming game at your school. The success of this visit rests on pitches that you select to give your recruit during his visit and the result of the game he attends.
[/olist]

[h1]In-Season[/h1]
Now that your head coach has been hired, your roster and depth chart tweaked, and your preseason recruiting board set up, it’s time to kickoff the season. Each week you will face a new opponent and try your best to climb the national ranks and win your conference. There are plenty of off-the-field responsibilities you will have to tend to throughout the season.

[h2]Recruiting[/h2]
The bulk of your recruiting responsibilities will take place throughout the season. Each week, you will be given more Prestige points to spend on scouting recruits, pitching your school, and scheduling visits. Each year, you will have 25 scholarships to hand out, so choose who you offer to carefully. 

[h2]XP[/h2]
Throughout the season, you will accrue XP in a variety of manners. You will earn XP through your on-field performance week to week and for completing game, season, and career coaching challenges. XP is used to upgrade your players and your coach.
[list]
[*] XP can be used to directly upgrade player stats from the “Improve Players” menu. 
[*] Unlock new coaching skills using XP. There are two main ways to improve your coach through these skill trees.
[*] [b]Upgrade Coaching: [/b]The higher your coaching level the more effective your coach becomes at influencing recruits. 
[*] [b]Skill Areas: [/b]The ratings in Maximum Football roll up into 7 main categories: core, passing, rushing, receiving, blocking, defense, and special teams. Upgrading your coach in any of these areas reduces the XP cost of upgrades in that category.
[/list]
[h2]Money[/h2]
In the same way that your program will accrue XP week to week, your school will earn and spend money each week. You will want to make sure that you are bringing in more money than you are spending in order to have profits to spend on improving your stadium and facilities. Let’s take a look at how you will earn money and how you will spend it.

[h2]Income[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/4522f8589dcc8841f7eec7f49e4d9bbfc6a67606.jpg[/img]
Your team’s income comes from 7 sources:
[olist]
[*] [b]Conference Distribution:[/b] Each year, your school will receive a payment from your conference that scales depending on the prestige of your conference. 
[*] [b]Government Support:[/b] Each year, every team across the league will get an on time payment from the government to upgrade their school. 
[*] [b]Merchandise:[/b] During the game, your team shop will sell items like jerseys, posters, and helmets, all of which you will be able to adjust the price of. 
[*] [b]Food Carts:[/b] You can choose to have as many or as few food carts as you’d like to serve your fans. Increasing the number of Food Carts at your stadium will increase the number of orders that can be placed during each game, but adding carts will also increase the upkeep cost for your stadium to run each week. 
[*] [b]Ticket Sales:[/b] You control the price of your tickets and each week, you can see how many of your available seats sold. Price your tickets too high and you won’t sell enough tickets. Price them too low and you won’t be able to cover your expenses. Attendance will also fluctuate based on the performance of your team. So if you are 1-5 going into Week 7, you might want to lower the price of tickets. 
[*] [b]Bowl Distribution:[/b] If your team reaches a bowl game at the end of the year, they will get a cut of the revenue generated from that event. This increases if you win the bowl. 
[*] [b]Championship Distribution:[/b] If you qualify for the post-season playoff, your team will receive a cut of the revenue based on how many rounds you made it through.
[/olist]
[h2]Expenses[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/b9133e2cb85afb518b5c05b314d40091eca21df4.jpg[/img]
The expenses that factor into your net income week to week include:
[olist]
[*] [b]College Upkeep:[/b] This is the cost to maintain your facilities (outside of your stadium). As you upgrade your facilities, the cost of their upkeep will rise. 
[*] [b]Game Expenses:[/b] These are the costs accrued by your team for each game they participate in, home or away. 
[*] [b]Merch Store Upkeep:[/b] This is the cost of stocking items in your merch store. 
[*] [b]Food Cart Upkeep:[/b] The cost of maintaining each food cart.
[*] [b]Stadium Upkeep: [/b]As you upgrade your stadium and attract more fans, more money will be spent on maintaining your stadium. These costs only accrue during weeks with home games. 
[*] [b]Coach and Staff: [/b]The cost of paying the salaries of your Coach and additional staff.
[/olist]
Money is important in your Maximum Football dynasty because it allows you to upgrade your stadium, facilities, and coaching staff. 

[b]Stadium:[/b] There are two ways to upgrade your stadium. 
[list]
[*] First, you can build a new stadium that seats more fans, allowing for more ticket revenue. 
[*] Next, you can upgrade the tier of your stadium. Doing this will add new amenities to your stadium for fans to enjoy. Things like expanded parking, larger scoreboards, and upgraded wi-fi will make the fan experience better. This increases the amount of money your fans will spend at your stadium each week but also increases the cost of upkeep. 
[/list]
[b]Facilities:[/b] Similar to how coaches can be upgraded through XP to impact player progression, you can use money to upgrade your facilities to the same effect. Upgrade facilities for core, passing, rushing, receiving, blocking, defense, and special teams to lower the XP cost of upgrading your player’s stats in these areas. Upgrading these facilities also dynamically changes the facility grade for your program in recruiting.

[h2]Weekly Match-Up[/h2]
Funny to think that we are 2,500 words into this blog and just now starting to talk about on-the-field play, but that’s just a testament to the level of depth and control you have in your Dynasty.

Each week, you will take on a different opponent to try to climb the ranks to college football glory, and even with this, you have full control over! You have several options for playing your game each week.
[olist]
[*] [b]Play: [/b]You can play the game outright. Take control of your team and lead them to victory. 
[*] [b]Spectate:[/b] Want to sit back and watch the fruits of your labor? Spectate the game to watch the CPU play the CPU. Note: You can also spectate any playoff, bowl or championship games - even when your own team isn’t involved.  
[*] [b]Simulate: [/b]Skip the game entirely and let Maximum Football’s sim engine decide the winner.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/6bb4c42ee6f01f65512c6ba0e54cec8a845e0803.jpg[/img]
In this menu, you can also choose to allow the CPU to apply earned XP and handle any unspent recruiting points. In the “Coaching Info” menu, you can change the recruitment priorities for the simulation choosing to prioritize high ranking prospects, filling team needs, and going after local prospects.

[h1]Bowl Season[/h1]
At the end of each season, if you’ve put together a successful regular season campaign, you will find yourself in your conference championship taking on the other top team in your conference. Qualifying for this game isn’t just about bragging rights. The top two teams in the conference will receive a chunk of revenue generated from the game with the winner receiving even more.

If your team is good enough to make it to the College Football Championship Tournament at the end of the year, you will be seeded based on your end of year ranking and take on a wave of competition to compete for the trophy. For every round you advance, your team will earn additional revenue, with a championship obviously resulting in the largest amount. This is also a great time to continue to earn XP towards player and coach progression as you compete while most other teams are watching from home.

If you missed out on a chance to compete in the tournament, your team could still qualify to compete in a bowl. These bowl games are also fully customizable! Rename the bowl and upload your own logo to replace the logos that exist in the game to create your own Bowl Season.

[h1]Off-Season[/h1]
Once the postseason wraps up, you will have a few tasks to take care of prior to starting your next season.

[h2]High School All-Star Game[/h2]
You’ve spent the entire year trying to convince the top high school athletes in the country to attend your school. Now, you can see them in action for the first time before they arrive on campus in the High School All-Star Game. You can either play the game outright or spectate and watch how the incoming class competes on the field.

[h2]Conference Realignment[/h2]
Depending on how frequently you have set conference realignment, you will be able to view the promotion and relegation of teams around the country.

[h2]Play Drills[/h2]
Each offseason, you will have the opportunity to complete a series of drills. Completing these drills will earn you additional XP that can be applied to your coach or used to upgrade your players.

[h1]More to Come[/h1]
Phew. That’s a lot of details! And there is certainly more to discover when you get your hands on Dynasty later this year. We can’t wait to see the leagues, teams, players, and storylines you create when you play Maximum Football’s Dynasty Mode. This mode, as with everything else in Maximum Football, will grow and evolve through early access and beyond.

Do you have questions about Dynasty Mode or want to connect with our community to see the College football universes that they create? Join our Discord to talk with the devs, see community team creations, and offer feedback and suggestions about the game.

notes.title: 6 Ways We Are Improving Maximum Football From the Beta
notes.content:
The Maximum Football Open Beta was a HUGE success. As a top-50 played game during Next Fest, we had no shortage of players offering insightful feedback on how we can improve the game. Here’s a list of six areas we are currently working on which will improve the game in the lead up to Early Access thanks to your participation in the Beta. 

You can watch the video about these improvement below or continue reading to learn about what we will be tackling as we prepare for Early Access. 

[previewyoutube=_gdYKQt0M6E;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Game Pace[/h2]
Game pace was an issue we addressed with the week 2, real-world speed update. While the change was largely well-received, it was a very quick change without the correct engineering behind it to commit it to the game. We’re working on that now alongside other areas of the game which need to change in order to properly support real-world speed. These include tweaking the physics, making adjustments to how acceleration works in the game, and ensuring there is a difference in feel from running and sprinting. 

[h2]Graphics, Animation and Audio[/h2]
We received an abundance of positive feedback about the visuals and animations in the game, but we still have some work to do to bring this up to where we want it to be. This includes camera work, particle effects, weather, and dirt. All of these will add to the visual fidelity of the game. 

We are also still working on our full suite of animations that we have captured for the game, as well as adding even more mocaped animations which we’re sure you’ll love in our Early Access.

[h2]Player Controls[/h2]
The controls in Maximum Football are also being revised in the lead up to Early Access with a few goals in mind: 
[olist]
[*] Create smoother controls
[*] Make the gameplay feel more responsive to user inputs
[*] Provide the user with better tutorials and practice modes to master the controls 
[/olist]
[h2]AI Players and Play calling[/h2]
Limiting the Beta to gameplay against the CPU meant that we were able to gather a bevy of feedback regarding the AI play calling and execution. 

With this feedback, we’re improving the AI coaching’s situational awareness, especially as it relates to clock management at the  end of a half and in late game situations. 

[h2]Playbooks[/h2]
Hand-in-hand with AI play calling, we are already on our way to improving the plays available to call as well as the actual 11-on-11 execution of the plays. We will also look into improving the in-game playart in both the play calling menu and the on-field view. 

These updates will require certain considerations before we  add custom playbooks and play creation to the game. 

[h2]UI[/h2]
We want to make sure Maximum Football is user-friendly and easy to navigate. Many of you commented on the UI needing some improvements. 

We are currently doing a full audit of the accessibility of our UI and looking for ways to improve it. 

As you can see, we’ve got a football field of work ahead of us as we move towards Early Access. We can’t wait to show you how YOUR FEEDBACK has created real change in Maximum Football.

notes.title: Thanks for Playing the Next Fest Open Beta!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Maximum Football Community[/h1]
The last two weeks have been an exciting time for us as a team, and hopefully for you as fans of Maximum Football! We've already received such an immense amount of encouragement and most importantly [i][b]actionable feedback[/b][/i] for us to make Maximum Football the best simulation football experience in gaming. 

As of 10 a.m. PDT, the Open Beta has officially come to a close, and we want to take the opportunity to relay a couple messages to the community that is making this game possible. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/052e108449804c6959327fd4aa35f82f2d36c192.jpg[/img]
[h2]Thank You for Playing[/h2]
Getting to this first publicly playable build for Maximum Football has been a journey and there's always a mix of excitement and nerves when you press that publish button. By taking the time to boot up Maximum Football and test it out, you've done us a great honor and helped bring some of that excitement into reality. From the bottom of our hearts, [i][b]thank you very much for playing[/b][/i] with the Roswell Greys and the Lubbock Firebirds, and for showing off your creativity in the game's create-a-team suite. 

[h2]We NEED Your Feedback[/h2]
The purpose of the Beta was to gather feedback from the community about what is good, what is bad, and what is on the right track to becoming good. We've already received a ton of great feedback via our survey, the Maximum Football Discord, Steam Discussions, and social media. Rest assured that if you've sent something along on these channels, it has been seen and compiled for the team to take a look at. 

As we've said many times, [i][b]we are building this game WITH you! [/b][/i]And your feedback matters. If you have not had the chance to yet, here are some ways to pass along your thoughts on the Beta:
[list]
[*] Most importantly, [url=https://lp.constantcontactpages.com/sv/Q0JrWjU]fill out the official Open Beta Survey[/url]. We are taking responses until Wednesday, June 26th. 
[*] Join the [url=discord.gg/S8yg7EG2gA]Maximum Football Discord Server[/url]. There you will find other fans of the game, channels to discuss feedback, request features, and share your team creations. There will also be plenty more to do in the lead up to Early Access. 
[*] Follow us on social media and respond to our posts. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/32b9540ce5b2018b2419f43b7815dff2e0a406d2.jpg[/img]
[h2]What Happens Next[/h2]
The end of the Open Beta is not goodbye and it's not even see you later. We still have tons of information to reveal in the lead up to Steam Early Access later this year. But here's what you can expect over the next few months. 

[h3]Continuing development for Early Access:[/h3]As you saw with the real-world speed update to the Open Beta, we are taking your feedback seriously. The immediate future for our development team entails reviewing your feedback, making changes to the game based on it, and getting our different modes and features ready for Early Access. During this time, we will also be working on implementing a lot of new animations and making tweaks to the physics and AI in the game. 

[h3]Development Updates and Reveals[/h3]While we continue working on development of the game behind the scenes, the conversation with you will continue. We have plenty to talk about and showoff before launching into Early Access later this year, so be sure to follow us on social media and join our Discord server. 

[h3]Early Access Launch[/h3]This is the moment we've ALL been waiting for: Putting Maximum Football in your hands! Early Access will feature a bevy of modes, including Play Now, Online H2H, Team Creator, Player Creator, Dynasty Mode and more. While we will launch a product we are proud of at this time, we will by no means be finished. There will be regular updates, added features, and added modes throughout Early Access and beyond. All of this will rely HEAVILY on your feedback to help. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/98b7b4bc5c3666abf28093b3a717f9fef1927d64.jpg[/img]
[h2]See You Soon[/h2]

notes.title: We're Extending the Open Beta With Build Updates!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Maximum Football Community[/h1]

The past week has been incredible! Seeing you get your hands on the game and share your thoughts about the good, the bad, and the ugly is exactly what this first public playtest was designed for. And you all showed up in a big way for us!

We have received tons of responses to our survey (if you haven't had a chance to fill that out, [url=https://lp.constantcontactpages.com/sv/Q0JrWjU]you can find it here[/url]), not to mention the comments that we've seen on the Steam community forums, X, Instagram, YouTube, Discord, and Reddit.

We want to make one thing absolutely clear; [b]WE ARE LISTENING! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/36cf7ebb53d0ab51b22dce27fc8ad508f5738d27.png[/img]

It's one thing for us to say that, but it's a whole other thing for us to show it. That's why we have just released a new patch for the Maximum Football Open Beta that addresses some of the biggest concerns that we saw from the community. 

[h2]Extending the Beta[/h2]
Our original plan was to run the Beta for the week of Steam Next Fest, but since you all shared great feedback and we made some changes based on that feedback, we are [b]extending the Beta one more week[/b]! We'd love for you to share your opinions on our changes, or maybe for the first time. 

You can now play the Beta through Monday, June 24th! 

[h3]Real Speed Open Beta[/h3]
One of the biggest pieces of feedback we received over the last week is that the gameplay is too slow. College and pro-level football features some of the most impressive athletes on the planet, and we want to make sure that Maximum Football feels like you are controlling these athletes. 

The biggest change users will notice is the new [i]real world simulation speed[/i]. We have calibrated player speed around 40-yard times between 4.2 and 5.7 seconds (depending on the speed rating of the player). This will allow the users to make quick cuts and quicker changes of direction. 

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
We have made other changes based on user feedback and you can find that complete list of bug fixes in the patch notes below. Please note that because we turned around a patch in a week, we were not able to address all your feedback and bug issues. As this is a Beta, you may encounter bugs, especially with the new updates. 

[previewyoutube=DpDsyP6iqds;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Continued Feedback[/h2]
We want to thank you so much for the feedback you have already given! Your passion for this game and the game of football are going to be what help us to make this the best simulation football game available. As you continue playing, keep sharing feedback with us. Here's how:

[h1]📝 Dev Note 📝
🚧 Work in Progress 🚧[/h1]

What's going on everyone! Welcome back to another Maximum Football development diary!

It feels like 100 years since our last video, but we've been grinding to make Maximum Football a true American Football Simulation video game.

With so much worked on since our last update, let's get into the massive update about AI, animations, physics, dynasty, customization, multiplayer, sfx, vfx, and so much more.

[h3]Gameplay - The Core Focus[/h3]
From day one, our top priority has been authentic gameplay. It's all about creating a realistic football experience at every position. Getting basic football mechanics correct has been our goal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/e84dcd1814f89e8719b23b6d6c9367c0974ce338.png[/img]

[h3]Blocking[/h3]
There have been extensive improvements in the blocking game, including the addition of pull blocks, downfield blocks, and open field blocks. Blockers can double team a defender when needed, and then detach from the double team to target a new defender when the new threat is detected. Other blocking updates include:
[list]
[*] Smart, dynamic blockers; size and attributes matter.
[*] No 3 or 4 person scenes that lock players into animations (like other football video games).
[*] Real-time adjustments, avoiding pre-made animation scenarios.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/88acb4746a26ab4331737571d6c4c1d05c7570a3.png[/img]

[h3]Passing[/h3]
We've added realistic QB styles, from pocket passing to throw-on-the-run style QBs.
Maximum Footballs' Advanced AI helps to identify open receivers and allow QBs with certain attributes to throw with more accuracy/power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/e279a00311a8b8a07eacda2aad282a4719f5db8e.png[/img]

[h3]Catching[/h3]
We've enhanced receiver attributes to help determine everything from how the receiver handles being pressed to how well the receiver can catch the football. Receivers can now adjust routes on the fly when passes are inaccurate or contested. We've also added hundreds of catching animations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/63dab466e3b7b92466efb1a252ee26e59f6e9dd9.png[/img]

[h3]Running Game[/h3]
For the running game, we've added the following mechanics.
[list]
[*] Smooth, responsive ball carrier mechanics.
[*] AI-led gap identification even in chaotic situations.
[*] Differentiated moves for power backs (stiff arm/truck) versus Speed backs (spin/juke)
[/list]

[h3]Defense[/h3]
On the defensive side of the ball, we've made the following improvements. 
[list]
[*] Improved man and zone coverage AI.
[*] Defensive gap assignment AI
[*] Advanced presnap adjustments, audibles, and player positioning.
[*] Attributes-driven play prediction and reaction.
[*] Physics tackles
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/f9b9c8725f3a1143395306927a1f4952d4ff705a.png[/img]

We've also worked on a number of non-gameplay specific updates, including:

[h3]Dynasty Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] RPG-like progression mechanics: player, coach, and facility upgrades.
[*] Realistic recruiting battles, scouting, and player development.
[*] Control every financial aspect, from ticket pricing to merchandise and concessions.
[*] Dynamic player and coach attributes that impact recruitment and gameplay.
[*] Extensive customization: league setup, season length, playoff bracket size, custom conferences, custom team imports, and player customization.
[/list]

[h3]Customization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Team customization updates
[*] Logo upload
[*] Advanced player customization: hair, body size, equipment, tattoos, and more.
[*] Customization sharing
[/list]

[h3]Multiplayer[/h3]
[list]
[*] Online ranking system
[*] Unranked online games
[*] Ranked online games
[/list]

Once again, Thanks for your patience. We can't wait for you to experience all these updates in Maximum Football when the game launches into Early Access in 2024. Stay tuned!

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/7bf22f72fe32e0dff464bd39e3b2dc2cf1d076ed.jpg[/img]

[b]Maximum Football Community,[/b]

We can't express enough gratitude for the excitement and anticipation shown from you all for Maximum Football. Our ambition for this project from the start has been to create a Free to Play, Physics Driven, Customizable football experience within deep Collegiate and Pro atmospheres. To that end, the development team is working hard to deliver a new and exciting experience at the quality level that meets this ambition and lets you etch your own story in sports greatness.
Therefore, after much evaluation, the team has decided to move the Steam Early Access launch to Fall of 2023.

We share your passion for gaming and the sport of football, and we know this is the right decision for Maximum Football and its fans. Thank you for your patience in waiting a little bit longer to get on the field.

Look for more in-depth information as we get closer to Early Access, and follow our social media channels and join our Discord for more updates.

[b]The Maximum Football Team[/b] 

PS: Check out our GAMEPLAY progress! First look! 

[previewyoutube=u6dIneeeVP0;full][/previewyoutube]

Question: [b]Why the delay? [/b]
Answer: Even though we’ve been pleased with the progress of development thus far, we feel that to deliver a title that meets or exceeds expectations more time is needed for development.

Question: [b]What is Early Access?[/b] 
Answer: Early Access is a place where games are playable in an alpha or beta state while they are under continued development. Games in Early Access should be considered unfinished. The reason for Early Access is it allows gamers to play and provide feedback to help shape a game and its features.

Question: [b]When is Early Access available? [/b]
Answer: Fall of 2023

Question: [b]Why bring MXFB to Steam Early Access instead of releasing the full game?[/b] 
Answer: We believe that providing access to players in an early state allows us to gather crucial feedback from the community to build the best possible experience.

Question: [b]Is GAMEPLAY still your focus?[/b] 
Answer: Yes! Gameplay has always been our focus for Maximum Football. We have been polishing and tweaking our gameplay as seen with recent DEV DIARIES and NOTES. We are incredibly passionate about getting it right and nailing a formula you’ll enjoy. It’s one of the prime reasons for the delay. We want to turn a few more screws before unleashing it in Early Access.

notes.title: DEVELOPER NOTE Ep. 3
notes.content:
[h1]Bring it in team! Bring it in! [/h1]

[h2]In another DEV NOTE, we hear from Micah our Development Director. He talks about the Quarterback and how defenders will treat him based off of his [i]"THREAT"[/i] level!  
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/445f749ef89f1c88d85ad01c53f38fba329f0a53.jpg[/img]

🚧 Work in Progress 🚧

“The QB is either a low, medium or high running threat depending on how close he is to the line of scrimmage, how close he is to the hash’s, and how fast he is moving. The faster he is and the closer he is to the LOS the more threat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/7720ee6515629c2b5bba4ef8f79b2b86125afbb8.jpg[/img]

Defenders will behave differently depending on the threat level of the QB. If he is a high threat they will abandon their responsibilities and chase him. If its a medium threat they will pursue the quarterback if they have no one else to guard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/3ee74fd997a0079d47a41b72a253553dbe043243.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/f7cfbea60640203a627ce063c2e441a10de00ec6.jpg[/img]

If the QB is a low threat the defenders will simply shade towards him without abandoning their current responsibilities. The red, yellow and orange circles indicate which defenders will react to the QB threat levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/f0554bbf6058575ef24ac0f733af2373b64f256c.jpg[/img]

If the QB is a High threat and the defender is within the Red circle then he will pursue the QB using the High Threat level AI. If the defender is in the Orange circle when the QB is a Medium Threat then the defender will behave with Medium Threat Level AI. If the defender is in the Yellow circle when the QB is a Low Threat then the defender will behave with Low Threat Level AI.”

Micah Brown
Development Director

[h1][b]Huddle up team! [/b][/h1]

[h2]We're going to bring you development updates to help keep everyone posted on the happenings here at Maximum Football! We hope you enjoy these under the hood looks at what we have going on in the locker room! [/h2]

Today we go inside the[i] mind of a running back![/i] These are the variables the development team is thinking about when designing HB logic. 

🚧 Work in Progress 🚧

“The ball carrier decides where to navigate based on a lot of factors: Where are the closest threats? Where are his blockers? Where is the end-zone? Where is the sideline? Where is the line of scrimmage and what direction is he currently going?”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43609941/90449c08335ff6a530d2c2c72e9e76052202d225.jpg[/img]

“These factors are dynamic. They change every frame. In one frame a certain path may be open. Next, the path may close up as defenders get into range. The RB is analyzing different paths. Deciding which will get to the endzone fastest, while avoiding the most immediate threats”
